ORDINANCE LVIII OF 1979
CENSUS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Census Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th October, 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Census (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 9, Ordinance X of 1959

2. Amendment of section 9, Ordinance X of 1959.-In the Census Ordi nance,
1959 (X of 1959), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 9,
in subsection (1), after the word "house" occuring for the first
time, the brackets, words and comma "(including any commercial, industrial
or other premises which are also used for the purpose of residence)" shall
be inserted.

3. Amendment of section 13, Ordinance X of 1959.-In the said
Ordinance in section 13-
(a) in clause (b), after the word
"return" occurring for the second time, the words and commas "or
fails to deliver or forward to the proper authority, or retains copies or
extracts from, the census returns or any Documents relating to the Census"
shall be inserted ;
(b) in clause (e), for the
full-stop at the end the comma and word "or" shall be substituted :
and
(c) after clause (e) amended as
aforesaid, the following new clause shall be added, namely :-
"(f) attempts to have a
false return made by a Census Officer."
